card.architecture: Latent diffusion (Cosmos-Predict2-derived, Qwen3-0.6B encoder, Qwen-Image VAE)
card.summary: The highest-quality anime-specific model here -- a 2B anime base with the cleanest output, the best hands/anatomy for anime characters of any model here, and strong character/artist/series knowledge. Also the SLOWEST of the anime models (40 steps, distinct architecture). Prompted primarily with danbooru tags. Non-commercial.
use_cases: anime characters / artists / series via booru tags
when anime quality matters more than speed
card.pick_when: Pick when you want the BEST anime quality and can accept the slowest generation (non-commercial use only). Booru-tag prompting.

prompt.guidance: The baseline quality prefix is prepended automatically -- do NOT type it. Tags lowercase with SPACES (not underscores), score tags excepted; prefix artist names with '@'. Order (your part, after the auto prefix): [1girl/1boy] [character] [series] [@artist] [general tags].

prompt.overview: Danbooru-tag model (Qwen3-0.6B encoder): comma-separated lowercase tags in a defined order (the baseline quality prefix is prepended automatically). Also accepts natural language or a tag/prose mix.
prompt.instructions:
The baseline quality prefix (the required_prefix `masterpiece, best quality, score_7,`) is prepended AUTOMATICALLY -- do NOT type it.
Write your tags in this order: 1girl/1boy/1other (subject count) > character > series > artist > general tags.

OPTIONAL extra quality/meta/time tags (only if the user asks; the baseline is already added): human-score `good quality, normal quality, low quality`; aesthetic `score_9` ... `score_1`; time `year 2025` plus `newest, recent, mid, early, old`; meta `highres, absurdres, anime screenshot, official art`; rating `safe, sensitive, nsfw, explicit`.
Artists/styles MUST be prefixed with `@`: when the user says 'in the style of X', 'by X', or '<X> style', output that name as the tag `@x` in lowercase (e.g. 'in the style of Greg Rutkowski' -> `@greg rutkowski`). Without the @ the style is IGNORED.
Use lowercase with SPACES, not underscores (e.g. `fur-trimmed gloves`) -- the score tags are the only exception and keep their underscores.
Weighting works but needs higher weights than SDXL (e.g. `(chibi:2)`). Text rendering is weak (single words / short phrases). Natural language is accepted (aim for 2+ sentences).
do: Order tags count > character > series > artist > general
Turn 'in the style of X' / 'by X' into the tag `@x` (lowercase); without @ the style is ignored
Lowercase + spaces, not underscores (keep score_ underscores)
Raise weights higher than usual SDXL values
dont: Type the baseline quality prefix (it is auto-prepended)
Omit the @ before artist names (effect becomes very weak)
